meal.title: Create a BeautifulSoup object with lxml parser
meal.objective: Instantiate a BeautifulSoup parser using the lxml engine.

voice.script: Ever tried to read a web page without a parser? We have raw HTML but no way to query it. First, we import BeautifulSoup from bs4. Then we create a soup object by calling BeautifulSoup with the html string and the lxml parser. That soup variable now holds a navigable tree of the page. Try loading a different page and print soup.title.text.
